author: Vox
description:
As homeownership slips further out of reach in America, more people are spending more of their lives as renters. But while renting offers many benefits — like flexibility and far lower upfront costs — many tenants live in fear of receiving their next lease renewal, not knowing if they’ll be displaced by the next rent hike. 

All of this begs the question: Why isn’t everything rent controlled? Vox’s Marina Bolotnikova explains why rent control is more complicated than we may think.
